assertion.hypotheses: The published CM order setup and a prime satisfying the displayed quadratic-symbol condition.
assertion.quantifiers: Every permitted old d, proper ideal-class translate and prime above ell.
assertion.parameter_range: ell outside6dND_K; no restriction to maximal orders or inert squarefree d.

assertion.normalizations: Quadratic symbol of order discriminant; geometric reduction after a finite local extension.

assertion.limit_order: Identify actual order discriminant and allowed prime, verify quadratic symbol, apply published assertion, then transport within the same order.
